headline: Gumroad vs Ko-fi Fees (2026): $20 Sale Keep
description: Compare Gumroad’s blended direct fees with Ko-fi free and Gold processing estimates—worked $100 examples, break-evens, and when each creator checkout wins.

itemListElement.name: Gumroad vs Ko-fi Fees (2026): $20 Sale Keep

mainEntity.name: Why is Gumroad so much higher than Ko-fi on $100?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gumroad’s ~12.9% + $0.80 is a storefront blended planning rate; Ko-fi free tips near ~5% (and Gold processing near ~2.9% + $0.30) target different jobs. Compare same-job checkouts, not tip jars vs product platforms blindly.

mainEntity.name: How much should I charge on Gumroad to net $100?

acceptedAnswer.text: About $115.73 using the ~12.9% + $0.80 blend: (100 + 0.80) ÷ (1 − 0.129). Confirm in /tools/gumroad-fee-calculator/ and on gumroad.com/pricing.

mainEntity.name: Does Ko-fi Gold remove all fees?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Gold can remove donation commission on eligible tips, but card processing-like fees remain. Our Gold schedule models processing near 2.9% + $0.30 for planning—verify current Gold benefits on Ko-fi.

mainEntity.name: Can I use both Gumroad and Ko-fi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many creators take tips on Ko-fi and sell downloads on Gumroad. Just reverse-price each catalog correctly and avoid splitting the same SKU across too many storefronts.

mainEntity.name: Should I move products to Stripe instead?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you can host checkout and support customers yourself, Stripe US list at 2.9% + $0.30 is far cheaper than Gumroad’s blend—but you own fraud, hosting, and UX. Model engineering time honestly.
